'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[artillery]] targets 15 areas in [[Sumy Oblast]], Ukraine, killing two [[civilian]]s near the village of [[Yampil, Sumy Oblast|Yampil]] and injuring nine others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-russian-shelling-ukraines-sumy-region-regional-authority-says-2024-09-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[China and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Reuters]] reports that [[Russia]] has begun production of thousands of Garpiya-A1 [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|long-range combat drones]] used against [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] [[civilian]] and [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|military targets]], that incorporate engines, parts, and [[technology]] from [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-produces-new-kamikaze-drone-with-chinese-engine-say-european-intel-2024-09-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[Humanitarian impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***The [[United States|U.S.]] [[Central Intelligence Agency]] reports that due to the ongoing war, [[Ukraine]]'s [[Mortality rate|death rate]] is now the highest in the world at 18.6 per thousand people, while its [[birth rate]] is the lowest at six children born per thousand people. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/38938 (''Kyiv Post'')]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
***Abu Ali Al-Tunisi, an [[Islamic State]] commander for whom the [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Department]] had offered [[United States dollar|$5]] million for information for, is killed during a joint [[United States]]–[[Iraq]] operation in [[Al Anbar Governorate]]. Ahmad Hamed Zwein, an Islamic State deputy commander in Iraq, is also killed in the operation. [https://apnews.com/article/iraq-syria-islamic-state-anbar-e8e397305c3d95847d7cf4215d3aba0a (AP)]
*[[War on drugs in Ecuador]]
**[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
***Maria Daniela Icaza, director of the [[Litoral Penitentiary]] in [[Guayaquil]], the largest prison in [[Ecuador]] and the site of [[September 2021 Guayaquil prison riot|the country's deadliest prison riot in 2021]], is fatally shot in her vehicle by suspected [[Illegal drug trade in Latin America|drug cartel gunmen]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ecuador-prison-director-killed-maria-daniela-icaza-driving/ (CBS News)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Two [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] are [[killed in action]] in clashes with [[separatist]]s in [[Kishtwar]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/fierce-encounter-breaks-out-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-kishtwar-6558579 (NDTV)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**A [[Redwan Force]] commander is killed and 17 injured in Israeli drone strikes in [[Ahmadiya]] and [[Kfar Remen]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/13/israels-war-on-gaza-live-dozens-more-killed-amid-anger-over-school-attack (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[President of the Comoros]] [[Azali Assoumani]] is stabbed and injured in an assassination attempt in [[Salimani]], [[Comoros]]. [https://apnews.com/article/comoros-president-attack-4e46a5799b1430ababf98c474e7c37b5 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2024 Boeing machinists strike]]
**More than 33,000 [[Boeing]] factory workers [[strike action|go on strike]] for the first time since [[2008 Boeing machinists strike|2008]] after rejecting a [[master contract (labor)|labor contract]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/09/13/boeing-workers-strike-reject-contract.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Typhoon Yagi]] in [[Northern Vietnam|northern]] [[Vietnam]] increases to 233 people, with more than 820 others injured, and 103 people still missing. [https://apnews.com/article/vietnam-flooding-typhoon-yagi-deaths-95c5de93c84e636c32f2a875c77db0fa (AP)]
**At least ten people are killed by [[flooding]] and [[landslide]]s caused by Typhoon Yagi in [[Thailand]], along with at least 33 people killed in [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/typhoon-yagi-batters-thailand-myanmar-as-vietnam-cleans-up/a-70215185 (DW)]
*A [[Bulgarian Air Force]] [[Aero L-39 Albatros|L-39 Albatros]] jet [[plane crash|crashes]] during rehearsals for an [[air show]] at the [[Graf Ignatievo Air Base]] near [[Plovdiv]], [[Bulgaria]], killing both pilots. [https://apnews.com/article/military-jet-crash-bulgaria-46e7faf0bcbd33a906f680593cc464f1 (AP)]
*Two people are presumed dead and at least two others are injured in an [[explosion]] and subsequent fire at a [[gas station]] in [[Clearwater County, Idaho|Clearwater County]], [[Idaho]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/idaho-gas-station-explosion-fire-cardiff-17c393b1ede0179ca6f3117e71459d09 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Germany–Kenya relations]], [[Immigration to Germany]]
**[[Germany]] and [[Kenya]] agree on a labour migration deal which will see 250,000 [[skilled worker|skilled]] and semi-skilled Kenyan workers go work in Germany amid a shortage of skilled labour in the [[Economy of Germany|German economy]]. The agreement will also simplify the return of [[Illegal immigration|illegal migrants]] to Kenya. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gegkkg14ko (BBC News)]
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]] 
**[[Government of Russia|Russia]] revokes the accreditation of six [[List of diplomatic missions of the United Kingdom|British diplomats]] and accuses them of [[espionage]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c7858qqzyv8t (BBC News)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo coup attempt]]
**A court in [[Kinshasa]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] 37 people to [[Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo|death]] for their alleged roles in the attempted [[Coup d'état|coup]] the prior May. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-verdict-trial-coup-americans-93ca1f26b27b0a45f239db12a3b1e1d5 (AP)]
*[[Rotherham child sexual exploitation scandal]]
**Seven men receive prison sentences ranging from six to 25 years for [[Sexual offences in English law|sexual offences]] against girls aged 11 to 16 that occurred in the town of [[Rotherham]], [[South Yorkshire]], [[Northern England]] from the late 1980s until 2013. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyly0rdyz0o (BBC News)]
*[[Bedfordshire Police]] arrest an 18-year-old man on suspicion of [[murder in English law|murder]] after three people are found dead in flat in a [[tower block]] in [[Luton]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0qeqydgekpo (BBC News)]
*Three young [[Chinese people in Italy|Chinese people]] are killed in a suspected [[arson]] attack on a shop in [[Milan]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/2024/09/13/three-chinese-youths-killed-in-milan-store-fire_9b2fa36e-3634-48c8-b567-106b1b7790d7.html (ANSA)]
*[[China]] increases the country's [[retirement age]] for the first time since 1978. Beginning in 2025, the retirement age for men will be increased to 63, and the retirement age for women will be increased to either 55 or 58 depending on their occupation. [https://www.npr.org/2024/09/13/g-s1-22510/china-retirement-age (NPR)]
